A [[Color/Legends|light green]]-skinned, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Twi'lek''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at some point, as she carried a lightsaber, but it is unknown whether she was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] or a fully trained [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] at the time of the [[Order 66/Legends|fall of the order]].<ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]&mdash;"Force Sensitive Exile"</ref> She still believed in the old ways of the Jedi Order and lived in exile on an unidentified jungle-like [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Believer" />
